privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how SeOrganize+ handles company, team and authorized integration data, including Google Calendar.

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller is 55.823.385 GUILHERME COSTA BARBOSA FAGLIONI, CNPJ 55.823.385/0001-89, at Rua José Gerardo Bessa, Silveira, Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, ZIP 31140-390. General contact: guilhermefaglioni.contato@gmail.com. Privacy contact: guilhermefaglioni.contato@gmail.com.

googleData.title: Google data
googleData.body: When you authorize Google Calendar, we may receive the stable Google account identifier, verified email, access and refresh tokens, event identifiers, titles, descriptions, times, timezone, attendees and response status.

calendarUse.title: How we use Google Calendar
calendarUse.body: We use this data to show calendar events, detect conflicts, create events, update events, delete events and send invitations when you request those actions. We do not use Google data for advertising, sale, credit profiling or purposes not described here.

storage.title: Storage and security
storage.body: Tokens are stored encrypted in the application environment. Events and attendees may have a local copy to connect the calendar to company work. Access is protected by authentication, permissions and company isolation.

sharing.title: Sharing and providers
sharing.body: Data is processed by Google for the authorized integration and by providers needed to operate the service, such as Supabase, hosting, database and billing providers. We do not sell Google data or transfer it for advertising.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: When Google Calendar is disconnected, we immediately delete credentials and Google-derived event and attendee mirrors; locally created events are preserved. We retain personal data while needed to provide the service and comply with legal obligations. After access ends, we delete or anonymize data when no legal, regulatory or rights-defense need requires retention. Fiscal, financial and audit records are retained for the applicable legal periods.

aiStudioProviders.title: AI Studio and providers
aiStudioProviders.body: AI Studio can use OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenCode Zen or OpenCode Go through the official connection selected by the company. At launch, API Key is the functional path. OAuth will be offered only when the provider officially documents and enables OAuth for third-party applications; this capability is currently unavailable in the catalog. The product does not collect passwords, cookies or personal account tokens to enable this integration.

aiStudioProcessing.title: AI Studio processing
aiStudioProcessing.body: To generate or refine a candidate, we send the current briefing, sanitized base HTML, attached reference images and, when applicable, the company directive, session summary and compacted session messages only to the selected provider model for that action. We do not send the same content to multiple providers, use implicit fallback or include client data, real proposals or secrets by default. The candidate and edited HTML remain in the browser until you choose to save.

aiStudioRetention.title: Ephemeral AI Studio data
aiStudioRetention.body: The encrypted session snapshot and reference images are temporary, with a 30-minute TTL. Images exist only in process memory, are released after generation, reset or exit, and are removed on expiry or process restart. Briefings, HTML, images, summaries and transcripts are not written to the database, usage events or logs, and discarded content is not resent to another provider. The company directive is an existing setting and is read only to compose the authorized request.

aiStudioTelemetry.title: Operational telemetry
aiStudioTelemetry.body: We record only operational metadata such as company, operator, provider, authentication method, model, request, sizes, latency, status, error category and token counts when supplied. Prompts, HTML, images, transcripts and secrets are not included in telemetry. Operational events are retained for no more than 90 days.

aiStudioCosts.title: Company costs
aiStudioCosts.body: The company is responsible for charges, limits and usage policies of the provider connected to the company. SeOrganize+ applies its own operational limits but does not control OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenCode Zen or OpenCode Go pricing, availability or billing.

rights.title: Rights and revocation
rights.body: Under the LGPD, you may request confirmation, access, correction, portability, information about sharing or deletion, and revoke Google access from company settings. To exercise rights, contact guilhermefaglioni.contato@gmail.com.

internationalTransfers.title: International transfers
internationalTransfers.body: Because we use global providers, data may be processed outside Brazil. We apply the contractual and technical safeguards required for international transfers under the LGPD and applicable rules.

limitedUse.title: Google data policy
limitedUse.body: Use of Google API data follows the Google API Services User Data Policy, including Limited Use requirements. We use this data only to provide or improve visible features and do not transfer it for advertising.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: Material changes to this policy will be published on this page and may require renewed consent when they change the purpose of Google data use.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms define the rules for use of SeOrganize+ by digital service providers, companies and teams.

service.title: The service
service.body: SeOrganize+ provides tools for tasks, projects, documents, calendar, proposals, contracts and receivables. The service does not replace professional legal, accounting or financial advice.

access.title: Access and companies
access.body: Users must provide truthful information, protect credentials and use only companies and data they are authorized to access. Each company is responsible for permissions granted to its members. By creating or using access, users state that they have read and agree to these Terms. The current version is identified on this page, and material changes will be communicated through available channels before taking effect.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: You may not use the service for fraud, abuse, rights violations, unauthorized access attempts, malware distribution or integrations that conflict with provider policies.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.body: Google Calendar and other providers are third-party services. By connecting an integration, you authorize the actions described in the product and may disconnect it at any time.

aiStudioUse.title: AI Studio use
aiStudioUse.body: AI Studio generates reviewable candidates for proposal templates. The company must be authorized to use the submitted briefing, HTML, images, directive and session context, avoid personal data or secrets, and review the result before saving or sharing it. AI output may be incomplete or incorrect and does not replace professional review.

aiStudioProviderAuth.title: AI provider authentication
aiStudioProviderAuth.body: OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go are independent providers. API Key is the functional launch method. The product may offer OAuth only when official support for third-party applications is documented; until that condition is met, the interface states that it is unavailable and does not request personal passwords, cookies or tokens.

aiStudioCosts.title: AI costs
aiStudioCosts.body: The company responsible for the connection is responsible for provider charges and limits. Each generation uses only the provider selected in the session, with no automatic fallback to another provider.

billing.title: Plans and billing
billing.body: Plans, prices, activation, cancellation and access periods are presented in the product. The company is responsible for payments and use by its members.

content.title: Content
content.body: The company retains rights to its content and is responsible for authorization to store and share information entered into the service, including client and attendee data.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The service depends on our infrastructure and third parties. We may perform maintenance, apply limits or suspend features to protect users, data and operations.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: Access may be terminated by the company or the service under these terms. Data handling and deletion after termination follow the Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to the terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. Material changes will be communicated through available product channels or this page.
